vulnerabilities.msg: Apache/2.4.41 appears to be outdated (current is at least Apache/2.4.54).
The anti-clickjacking X-Frame-Options header is not present.
HTTP TRACE method is active, suggesting the host is vulnerable to XST
mod_ssl 2.8.7 and lower are vulnerable to a remote buffer overflow. CVE-2002-0082, OSVDB-756.
